caption:
Yusuf's words of forgiveness to his brothers

Yusuf told his brothers there was no blame on them that day, and asked Allah to forgive them, for He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. Think of one person you could forgive tonight.

Surah Yusuf 12:92

Forgive one person tonight, even if only in your heart

#forgiveness #storyofyusuf #letitgo #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
